\[
W = \begin{bmatrix}
  52 & 61 & 58 \\
  49 & 255 & 63 \\
  55 & 0 & 60
\end{bmatrix}
\]

Sorted: 0, 49, 52, 55, 58, 60, 61, 63, 255. The midpoint is (0 + 255) / 2 = **127.5**. Both impulses decide the result, and none of the seven ordinary values count. Without the two impulses, the window values run from 49 to 63, and the midpoint would be 56.
